prompt: On the Apps page (src/features/apps/index.tsx), when the search filter or the connection type leaves no app to show, the grid is simply empty. Show an empty state there instead: a short message saying that no app matches, and a button labelled "Clear filters" that clears the search text and resets the type to all apps, so every app shows again. Keep it consistent with the rest of the app.

constraints.text: Built from the app's existing components (Button and the others in src/components/ui), not new hand-made ones.
No colour, size or spacing typed by hand: the theme's tokens and Tailwind's scale only.
Shown for both causes (a search with no match, a type with no app), right in a narrow window and in the dark theme; the normal grid unchanged.
The message is announced to screen readers when it appears; the button is a real button named "Clear filters".
Only the Apps feature changes; nothing else in the app, and no test removed.
